Head: f932c3867649bd5849616abdc05fd684fd7688ca. The PR merges with `origin/main` (0306743de) without conflicts (`git merge-tree` gives tree debe8a413). There is no earlier review on this PR. The five earlier comments are status comments of the author about merges of main and stopped gates.

## Blockers

1. **No green gate on the final head.** The body says "The gate is INCOMPLETE and is owed". The gate on d067defa4 stopped at step 553. The gates on 1e10d5026 and f932c3867 stopped at steps 118 and 78. The Pull Request Law needs the quick gate of the author to be green on the final head, with the pinning tests and the `camcraft-ui` lib tests named. Run the quick gate on the final head. Then write the result into the body.

2. **`crates/app/src/stock_fit.rs:89-96` (`fit_command`): "Fit to models" puts a world-frame size into a laid stock.** The fit calculates the box or the cylinder from the world bounds of the parts (`fit_box`, `fit_cylinder_about`). Then it keeps the stored turn of the stock (`Location { pos, rot }`). Before this PR, the page could set only a turn about Z. Now "Along X" is one click on the same page as "Fit to models". Example: a box stock along X, then "Fit to models". The stock Z (the fitted `dz`) goes to world +X from the base point. The fitted `dx` goes to world Z, and the box is centred on the bottom of the parts. The result does not hold the parts, and no message shows. The UI (`State::apply_stock_fit`) and the MCP `fit_stock` tool use this same path. Do one of these:
   - Fit in the frame of the stock: transform the part bounds by the inverse of a square turn, then fit.
   - Or refuse the fit by name when the turn of the stock is not a turn about Z.
   Pin the result with a test: a box along X and a cylinder along Y, each with "Fit to models".

3. **`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`: the file goes from 387 to 412 lines** in the merged tree. The 400-line rule applies. Move `stock_turn` (line 251) and `set_stock` (line 271) into a module of their own. A possible name is `mcp/stock_tools.rs`.

## Readers of the stock shape (checked with `git grep`)

- Simulation start stock (`stock_sim.rs:73`), carried body (`stock_sim_held.rs:138`, `:153`), field view (`stock_view.rs:278`): each one goes through `stock_follow::sim_frame`. A laid cylinder gets `LAID_CYLINDER` by name. A tilted stock gets `OBLIQUE_STOCK` by name. A box laid along X or Y is cut as the same solid without the turn. OK.
- Post verdict (`posting_sim.rs:85`): a sim refusal becomes the "not judged" line, and the generator-time verify judges the ops. This is the #2177 law, and it does not change here. OK.
- Heights (`operation/heights.rs:62-63`), vise fit (`vise_fit.rs:62`), mod vise (`commands/mod_vise.rs:68`), WCS origin (`setup_origin.rs:27`), rest across setups (`rest/across.rs:187`), generator stock (`operation/job.rs:212`): each one reads the world box of the turned mesh. This follows the turn. For a tilted stock, the box is larger than the solid, which is on the safe side. OK.
- `commands/align_stock.rs:73-89`: a cylinder that stays laid is refused by name. OK.
- `commands/move_model.rs:154` via `stock_follow::keep_square`: square turns only, else a rigid carry. OK.
- `sketch.rs` (`stock_face`): changed by this PR. It refuses by name (`NO_TOP_FACE`). OK.
- Turning: no lathe reader reads the stock shape. OK.
- `stock_fit.rs`: see blocker 2.

## Other checks

- Command: Apply sends `CommandKind::SetStockPose` to the undoable `SetStock`. `SetStock::new` normalises the quaternion and refuses one that is not valid. `stock_axis_rot` refuses a NaN or infinite angle before the command. Undo is pinned in the app and in the UI. OK.
- Project file: the turn uses the existing `Location.rot`. An old file loads as upright. `a_turned_stock_survives_the_project_file` pins the round trip. OK.
- MCP: `set_stock` takes `axis` or `angles_deg`, and the skill row is updated. `Process change: yes` is in the body, and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` does not change. OK.
- UI: `layout_page_stock` has the "Stock axis" anchor. No snapshot PNG changes. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes from 1453 to 1457. There are before and after pictures in the body. OK.
- Layering: the new UI files use no `sys_*` or world calls. No new component. A decision file is present. The body has the `Changelog:` line and the closing line. OK.

## Notes (not blockers)

- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` goes from 400 to 404 lines. It is a registry table. A split is optional.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` goes from 4904 to 4908 lines. It was already much larger than 400 lines before this PR.
- `stock_axis_rows.rs:31`: the axis row is a radio row outside the property grid. The three angle rows (line 41) have no hover text. Give each angle row a short tooltip.
- For a laid stock, the "Z bottom" field is the height of the axis, not the bottom. The `TURNED_HINT` text says this. A field label that follows the axis is a possible follow-up (P7).
- The setup sheet (`setup_sheet/sections.rs:31`) does not show the turn of the stock. This is a possible follow-up (P7).
- No test pins redo after undo of the axis change. Add one line to `set_stock_lays_a_cylinder_along_x_and_undo_restores_the_old_turn`.

## Findings of the review on f932c3867

1. **No green gate on the final head.** Met. The results are below.
2. **"Fit to models" puts a world-frame size into a laid stock** (`stock_fit.rs`). Fixed with the first option of the review: the fit is made in the frame of the stock.
   - `stock_fit::fitted_turned` turns each part vertex back by the turn of the stock. It fits there, then turns the base point onto the setup frame.
   - `fit_command` uses it, so the Stock page and MCP `fit_stock` get the same result. An upright stock uses the old path.
   - Pinned by `fit_to_models_wraps_the_part_in_a_laid_stocks_frame` (`crates/app/tests/stock_axis.rs`). It tests a box along X (the exact world box of the part plus 2 mm on each side) and a cylinder along Y (a snug diameter and length, with each part corner inside).
   - A stock turned about Z now also fits on its own axes. The decision file records this.
3. **`mcp/edit.rs` over 400 lines.** Fixed. `stock_turn` and `set_stock` moved to the new file `crates/app/src/mcp/stock_tools.rs`. `edit.rs` now has 374 lines.

Notes of the review that are also done:
- Redo after undo is pinned in `set_stock_lays_a_cylinder_along_x_and_undo_restores_the_old_turn`.
- Each custom angle row has hover text.

## Changes from the merges of main

Main merged #2758, and the simulation now cuts a cylinder laid along X or Y. The merge had no text conflicts, but the code had to follow main:
- The Stock page shows the simulation note only for a stock that is tilted off the axes. `SIM_NOTE_LAID` is removed. The UI test is now `a_laid_stock_shows_no_simulation_note_and_a_tilted_one_does`.
- `sketch::stock_face`: since #2758, `sim_frame` keeps the turn of a laid cylinder. The face therefore came back as a vertical end face. It now refuses by name (`NO_TOP_FACE`) when the frame does not look up.
- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` is written again from the live tool table, because of the changed `set_stock` and `fit_stock` rows.

- On ee65e8666 these app suites pass: `stock_axis` (6), `mcp_doc_drift` (5), `stock_fit_fixtures` (10), `sketch_profile`, `sketch_project`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `contour_dxf_sketch_mixed`, `contour_dxf_sketch_verify`.
- `camcraft-ui` lib on b44e15628: 1388 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. ee65e8666 changes no UI code.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` on ee65e8666: clean.
- Unit sweep: removed 2457 superseded test unit dirs, 78.9 GB.
- Heavy lanes: the dry run reaches 234 lanes (197 app, 37 motion). Not run. The cut gate covers them (P4).
